## Before you submit

- [ ] My project is a **public** repository on GitHub or Codeberg.
- [ ] The repository has a **README** describing the project.
- [ ] (Recommended) The repository has tagged releases with the firmware attached as release assets (e.g. `my-project-v1.2.0.bin`).
- [ ] I added exactly one file per platform, at `projects/<id>.json`, and the `id` matches the filename.

## Automated checks

- [ ] The **Validate** check passes (format, filename matches `id`, no duplicate repo + platform).
- [ ] My repository is public and has a README (a maintainer checks this during review).
- [ ] I understand listing is not an endorsement: Synthux does not test or audit listed firmware.
